people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them before the LORD as a wave offering.
translations.kjv: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.
translations.asv: and he put the whole upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and waved them for a wave-offering before Jehovah.
